# The current child signed-state assertion still targets the parent document

Within the block labelled "properties of the opened attachment window", the signed-state assertion calls hasNoSignedIconState(aboutMessage.document). The child is aboutMessage2, and the adjacent encrypted-state assertion does use its document. Scoped test recommendation: inspect the intended child signed state and target that child explicitly; leave the subsequent parent-side-effect check separate. This is a static target gap, not proof that the child icon is wrong in a running build. This is static source and test-code inspection at the frozen accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remain pending; a landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.

Scope: OpenPGP child window signed assertion target.
